outcome: umbilical cord arterial blood gas values (pH, PaCO2, PaO2, SaO2, HCO3, and CtO2)
cohort: 47 parturients scheduled for elective cesarean section
finding: General anesthesia may be more favorable than epidural anesthesia in those undergoing cesarean section when fetal oxidative status is important.
mod_finding: The study found that general anesthesia may be more favorable than epidural anesthesia during cesarean section in terms of fetal oxidative status.
